description: Detailed image properties inspector with collapsible sections for the picture (URL and caption), size and rotation with aspect lock, text wrapping, position (alignment, X/Y, anchor lock), z-order, and accessibility (alt text, decorative). Dispatches changes debounced.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: Image content displayed by the inspector.

parameters.name: AlignmentChanged
parameters.description: Raised when text wrapping mode changes.

parameters.name: AltTextChanged
parameters.description: Image content displayed by the inspector.

parameters.name: BringForward
parameters.description: Raised when the object anchor lock changes.

parameters.name: CaptionChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the caption should be toggled.

parameters.name: LockAnchorChanged
parameters.description: Raised when image object position offsets change.

parameters.name: SendBackward
parameters.description: Raised when the image should move one layer forward.

parameters.name: ToggleCaption
parameters.description: Raised when decorative image mode changes.

parameters.name: UrlChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the image caption text changes.

parameters.name: WrapModeChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the source URL of an URL-backed image changes.
